en.title: Indices Whose Removal Keeps a Palindrome
en.description:
Given a lowercase string that is already a palindrome, count the indices whose removal still leaves a palindrome; equal characters at different indices are counted separately.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, examples, and judging.
en.input: A single line containing a palindrome string of length 2..100000.
en.explanation: Example 1: removing any z gives zz, 3 indices in total. Example 2: only one of the two middle b can be removed, giving aba, 2 in total. Example 3: only removing the center c gives abba, so the answer is 1.
hints: Find the block of consecutive identical characters that contains the center of the string; the answer is its length.
